hero.title: remember the email. *not the exact words.*
hero.lede: Search Gmail by meaning, see which senders fill your week, and turn recurring noise into durable filters. The model, messages, and search index stay in your browser.
hero.note: Read-only Gmail · No server-side mailbox copy · In-browser ONNX

blocks.title: a working *inbox cockpit.*
blocks.lede: Kinetic pairs three jobs that normally live in separate tools: recall an email, understand the senders behind the volume, and make Gmail quieter.

points.title: describe what you remember.
points.body: Embeddings are generated and compared on-device.

points.title: see who owns your inbox.
points.body: Sender analytics turns an abstract feeling of overload into a ranked, inspectable list.

points.title: turn recognition into relief.
points.body: Review suggested Gmail filters, export them, and let the rules work when Kinetic is closed.

blocks.title: your inbox *stays yours.*
blocks.lede: Messages, cached bodies, embeddings, and the semantic index live in IndexedDB in your browser. Kinetic’s server keeps only the authentication records needed for the read-only Gmail connection and proxies live Gmail calls.

blocks.title: before you hand any app *your inbox.*

items.q: can kinetic send, archive, or delete email?
items.a: No. The Gmail connection is read-only. Kinetic cannot compose, send, archive, or delete messages.
Inside your browser with HuggingFace Transformers and ONNX. The resulting embeddings stay in IndexedDB on that device.

items.q: what happens when i clear browser storage?
items.a: Your local index and cached mailbox data are removed. Kinetic must rebuild them from Gmail after you reconnect.
No. It is a focused workspace for semantic recall, sender analysis, unsubscribe help, and filter recipes on top of Gmail.

blocks.title: find the email *you can almost describe.*
blocks.note: Read-only access. Local index. Disconnect whenever you want.

footer.summary: Semantic Gmail search and sender intelligence that runs in your browser.
